newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QUF says 1996/97 profit to rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QUF says 1996/97 profit to rise.

text.p: Dairy food group QUF Industries Ltd said on Thursday that it expects earnings in 1996/97 (July/June) to show a significant improvement on the year-ago result.

"In the absence of unforeseen circumstances, the directors expect that the profit for the year to 30 June, 1997, will show a significant recovery," the company said in a statement accompanying its first half profit report.
It said the profit recovery will be due to the pattern of improved first half trading resuls continuing into the second six months.
"Current economic conditions including cautious consumer spending, low inflation but higher wage expectations do no provide an ideal environment for earnings growth," QUF also said.
